paper.title: Flocks, herds and schools: A distributed behavioral model

headline: Reynolds 1987 Boids (agent-based): 2/3 locked clauses REPRO; full phi=0.671 vs alignment-OFF phi=0.051; mean-NN 0.73 (uniform-spacing 3.54)

verdicts.gate: P1 full 3-rule model flocks: mean steady phi > 0.7 (coherent common heading)
reasons: full-model mean steady phi = 0.6710 over 5 seeds (range [0.661, 0.678]); need > 0.7

verdicts.gate: P2 alignment-OFF control does not flock: mean steady phi < 0.3 (no common heading)
P3 cohesion holds: full-model mean nearest-neighbour distance bounded (no dispersal)

extra.scope: faithful reproduction of a published synthetic model; no real-world data; the contribution is whether the harness + discipline reproduce emergent flocking and isolate alignment as its cause, and would catch an artifact

citations: Reynolds, C.W. (1987). Flocks, herds and schools: A distributed behavioral model. Computer Graphics (SIGGRAPH '87 Proceedings) 21(4):25-34. doi:10.1145/37402.37406.

benchmark.note: no cross-tool baseline; faithful single-implementation reproduction graded against the order parameter phi + mean nearest-neighbour distance
